sources.snippet: Save 🧪 plamo-embedding-1b Model Overview Overview PLaMo-Embedding-1Bis a Japanese text embedding model developed by pfnetthat converts Japanese text into 2048-dimensional numerical vectors. The model contains 1 billion parameters and supports a maximum context length of 4096 tokens, though it was trained with a context length up to 1024 tokens.
